name: Duong cha la
summary: Đuông chà là is the palm grub. The airline page says it is fat and white, taken from the palm trunk, and that not everyone will eat it.
origin: The cape countryside. The page prints no shop name.
howToEat: Eat it with nước mắm. The airline page prints no further recipe. A season was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: The cape countryside, when it is offered. Check on arrival for a price.
seoDescription: Đuông chà là is the palm grub of the Cà Mau countryside, eaten with nước mắm. Not everyone will want it.
